newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MRCB says has 27.1 pct equity in Rashid.
newsitem.headline: MRCB says has 27.1 pct equity in Rashid.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) said it holds 27.1 percent equity interest in stockbroking and banking group Rashid Hussain Bhd as at June 5 this year.

In a statement received on Friday to announce completion of its acquisition of 66.13 million Rashid shares and subscription of a further 34.7 million shares, MRCB said it now holds 104.33 million Rashid shares.
The company paid for the acquisition of the 66.13 million shares by issuing 130.6 million new MRCB shares at 8.0 ringgit apiece.
MRCB, a property, publishing and broadcasting group, has another 3.5 million Rashid shares which were acquired in the open market.
